content.text: Root cause: Docker runs `BUILD_GUI=OFF`, which skips DOTS, and it never copies `traj-compression`, so CMake can't find the baseline sources. Decoupling DOTS from the GUI and updating the Docker build.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(simplification_of_trajectory_stream CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
    add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
    add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()

# Optional Qt viewer (Widgets / OpenGL). Default ON for local development.
# Set to OFF for headless builds (Docker / Cloud Run). DOTS only needs Qt6
# Core and is built with the other baselines below, not gated on this flag.
option(BUILD_GUI "Build the Qt viewer (simplify_with_gui)" ON)

# Headless simplify binary — always built, no Qt dependency.
find_package(CGAL REQUIRED)
add_executable(simplify
  simplify.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(simplify
  CGAL::CGAL
)

# Baseline binaries used by the web compare pane and benchmark.py.
# dp / squish need no Qt. dots needs Qt6 Core only (see its CMakeLists).
add_executable(dp traj-compression/batch/DP/DP_adapted.cpp)
add_executable(squish traj-compression/online/SQUISH/SQUISH_adapted.cpp)
add_subdirectory(traj-compression/online/DOTS)

if(BUILD_GUI)
  # Qt-only builds need AUTOMOC for the Q_OBJECT types in the GUI target.
  set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
  set(CMAKE_AUTORCC OFF)
  set(CMAKE_AUTOUIC OFF)

  find_package(CGAL REQUIRED COMPONENTS Qt6)
  find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Widgets OpenGL OpenGLWidgets Svg)

  add_executable(simplify_with_gui
    simplify_with_gui.cpp
    drawing.cpp
  )
  target_link_libraries(simplify_with_gui
    CGAL::CGAL_Qt6
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Widgets
    Qt6::OpenGL
    Qt6::OpenGLWidgets
    Qt6::Svg
  )
  target_compile_definitions(simplify_with_gui PRIVATE CGAL_USE_BASIC_VIEWER)
endif()

FROM ubuntu:22.04 AS builder

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    libcgal-dev \
    qt6-base-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /build

# Headless simplify sources
COPY simplify.cpp simplify_geometry.h simplify_io.h timer.h CMakeLists.txt ./

# Baseline sources for the web compare pane (dp / squish / dots).
# DOTS needs Qt6 Core at build time; the full GUI stack is not required.
COPY traj-compression/batch/DP/DP_adapted.cpp ./traj-compression/batch/DP/
COPY traj-compression/online/SQUISH/SQUISH_adapted.cpp ./traj-compression/online/SQUISH/
COPY traj-compression/online/DOTS/CMakeLists.txt \
     traj-compression/online/DOTS/dots.cpp \
     traj-compression/online/DOTS/DotsSimplifier.cpp \
     traj-compression/online/DOTS/DotsSimplifier.h \
     traj-compression/online/DOTS/Helper.cpp \
     traj-compression/online/DOTS/Helper.h \
     traj-compression/online/DOTS/DotsException.cpp \
     traj-compression/online/DOTS/DotsException.h \
     ./traj-compression/online/DOTS/

# BUILD_GUI=OFF skips simplify_with_gui (no Widgets/OpenGL). Baselines still
# build: dots via Qt6 Core, dp/squish with no Qt.
RUN cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_GUI=OFF && \
    cmake --build build --target simplify dots dp squish -j"$(nproc)"

# Final stage: Python runtime on Ubuntu
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Install Python and runtime dependencies.
# CGAL is header-only at build time; simplify needs GMP/MPFR at runtime.
# dots needs Qt6 Core (libQt6Core).
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    python3.11 \
    python3-pip \
    libgmp10 \
    libmpfr6 \
    libqt6core6 \
    curl \
    ca-certificates \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Julia via the official install script. It auto-detects the current
# platform architecture (x86_64 vs aarch64), downloads the right tarball via
# juliaup, and exposes the `julia` binary on PATH. The default install root
# is /root/.juliaup when running as root, which we add to PATH for later
# steps. The Ubuntu 22.04 apt repo does not ship a usable `julia` package,
# so this is the canonical install path.
ENV JULIAUP_INSTALL=/root/.juliaup
ENV PATH="$JULIAUP_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
RUN curl -fsSL https://install.julialang.org -o /tmp/julia-install.sh \
    && sh /tmp/julia-install.sh --yes \
    && rm /tmp/julia-install.sh

# Sanity-check that the julia binary actually runs in the final image
RUN julia --version

# Make python3.11 the default
RUN update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python python /usr/bin/python3.11 1 && \
    update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3.11 1

WORKDIR /app

# Copy compiled binaries from builder (web compare pane needs all four)
COPY --from=builder /build/build/simplify /app/build/simplify
COPY --from=builder /build/build/dots /app/build/dots
COPY --from=builder /build/build/dp /app/build/dp
COPY --from=builder /build/build/squish /app/build/squish

# Copy web application files
COPY web/ /app/web/
COPY data/ /app/data/
COPY scripts/ /app/scripts/

# Install Python dependencies
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r /app/web/requirements.txt

# Pre-install the FrechetDist and ArgParse Julia packages so the first
# /api/frechet request doesn't pay the full Pkg.add cost (and so the image is
# self-contained). ArgParse is required by scripts/frechet.jl for --batch and
# --raw flag parsing.
RUN julia -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.add(["FrechetDist", "ArgParse"])'

# Set environment variables
# Default to 5050 to match local Flask (`python server.py`) and avoid macOS
# AirPlay on 5000. Cloud Run still injects PORT (typically 8080) at runtime.
ENV PORT=5050
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

EXPOSE 5050

# Run the Flask server
CMD ["python", "/app/web/server.py"]

content.text:
Yes - that was a real CMake/Docker gap on `other-algo`.

**Cause**
1. `Dockerfile` used `-DBUILD_GUI=OFF`, and DOTS was gated behind that flag, so it never built.
2. Docker only copied `simplify` sources - not `traj-compression` - so CMake failed looking for `DP_adapted.cpp` / SQUISH / DOTS.

**Fix** (in `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/simplification-of-trajectory-streams` on `other-algo`):
- `BUILD_GUI` now only controls `simplify_with_gui`
- `dots` / `dp` / `squish` always build (`dots` needs Qt6 Core only)
- Docker installs `qt6-base-dev` / `libqt6core6`, copies baseline sources, and builds/ships all four binaries
- CI installs `qt6-base-dev` so configure still works with `BUILD_GUI=OFF`

Verified locally: `cmake -DBUILD_GUI=OFF` builds `simplify`, `dots`, `dp`, and `squish`. Docker daemon isn’t running here, so the image wasn’t rebuilt.

**Note:** `traj-compression` still has local edits (DOTS path walking + timing). Docker COPY picks those up from the working tree; for a clean remote build you’ll want those submodule changes committed/pushed too.
